answer: Use a TPM-bound identity card: one agent identity is anchored to one chip, never to a free account. First, the chip creates a key that never leaves the hardware and proves it is genuine. Second, the network issues one card per chip after a 48-hour check. Third, each job needs a chip signature, so a copied card is useless without the chip, and peers revoke cards signing conflicting jobs. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 chips costing $350,000 plus 60 days of checks. Like an ember in one fireplace, a trellis holding one vine, a terrace holding one garden, one chip holds one identity.
